defects.description: Admission sets the shared key expiry only on the first increment, so a continuously occupied tenant loses newer live reservations when the key expires.
defects.why_missed: The existing two-gateway suite runs short bursts that drain to zero and never advances the store clock beyond a lease while newer slots remain live.

defects.description: Release decrements the tenant counter without checking whether the supplied reservation still owns a live slot, letting a late completion consume a newer holder's occupancy.
defects.why_missed: The existing suite completes every nonzero reservation once while its lease is live; it never completes a reclaimed reservation after replacement admission.
